en.name: Pokémon 9-frame loose-leaf collection card book 30th Celebration will be released soon
en.desc:
Pokémon 9-frame loose-leaf collection card book 30th Celebration will be released soon
On November 20, 2026, “Pokémon 9-frame loose-leaf collection card book 30th Celebration” (宝可梦9格活页收藏卡册 30周年庆典) will meet with the majority of trainers. The card book adopts a detachable loose-leaf design, which allows you to flexibly increase or decrease the number of pages and adjust the order, making card collection easier and freer. Pair it with the “Pokémon 9-frame card collection loose leaf 30th Celebration” (宝可梦9格卡牌收藏活页 30周年庆典) launched at the same time, and build your own little world of card collection.
“Pokémon 9-frame loose-leaf collection card book 30th Celebration” (宝可梦9格活页收藏卡册 30周年庆典) Adopts a 3-hole ring buckle design, which can flexibly increase or decrease the number of loose leaves, allowing the capacity of the card book to be flexibly expanded as the collection changes. If you want to change the order in which the cards are displayed, you can also adjust the order of the sheets easily.
The card book comes with 10 9-slot card collection sheets, each sheet has 18 slots in total. Collect and organize your favorite Pokémon cards in this card book as you like.
